title: Send a link to request view-only phone sharing
summary: Adds a private Tailscale invitation from the viewing phone, explicit approval on the second Android phone, automatic viewer handoff and host-enforced view-only access.
components: Android phone capture and invitation server

changes.detail: Private ten-minute, one-device viewing invitation with share/copy, explicit consent, expiry, cancellation and automatic in-app viewer connection.
Viewer hides remote controls for view-only sessions; Arabic, French and English explain setup and consent.
View-only host rejects input even if Accessibility is enabled and excludes saved control credentials; capture starts without requiring Accessibility.

validation.name: Automated validation
validation.detail: TypeScript, lint, native protocol and interaction checks pending.

validation.name: Physical phones and deployment
validation.detail: Requires updated native Android builds and Tailscale on both phones; no installation, public deployment or two-phone test has been performed.
